candidates.decision_relevance: Comparable breadth history would help distinguish persistent participation deterioration or recovery from isolated endpoint snapshots when assessing conflicting continuation and distribution interpretations.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily outputs repeatedly cite top-100 or rich-breadth snapshots as proxy-only, with changing membership hashes and no comparable sequence; weekly reviews also note missing quantitative breadth sequences.
candidates.metric_name: Point-in-time constituent returns and advancer/decliner status for a consistently defined breadth universe
candidates.missing_history_problem: Available breadth is largely snapshot-based and sometimes non-comparable across captures, preventing assessment of persistence and whether breadth changes preceded or followed price weakness.

candidates.decision_relevance: A continuous settled-flow record would clarify whether reported BTC/ETH flow divergence persisted, reversed, or coincided with the observed price and participation changes.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily reviews often have only one settled session, or cite aged ETF rows and missing intervening sessions; weekly reviews note absent or directionally unspecified ETF sequences.
candidates.metric_name: Daily settled BTC and ETH ETF net flows, with session dates and reported source units
candidates.missing_history_problem: Sparse and stale settled-flow observations do not establish within-period sequence or persistence, limiting comparison with weekly returns and rebounds.

candidates.decision_relevance: A sustained, synchronized record would help determine whether brief spot microstructure snapshots represented persistent participation conditions or transient episodes alongside the price path.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily reviews describe brief, exchange-specific depth and taker-imbalance snapshots, sometimes with conflicting signs, and report that spot-owner history is disabled or unavailable.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped BTC and ETH spot depth imbalance and executed taker-buy/sell quote imbalance, with venue and sampling-window metadata
candidates.missing_history_problem: Brief snapshots lack comparable historical persistence and sequence, making it difficult to distinguish sustained spot participation changes from momentary conditions or venue-specific observations.
